items.title: Jack Palmer interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 24, 1997
items.q: No, my father brought me to Professor Chambroka who was with the Rome White Band Hall

ctx.x: Even before you started the trumpet, can you recall what kind of music you were hearing as a child?

No I couldn’t say off hand. Because my father brought home a trumpet when I was thirteen years old. So really just before that all I knew was singing in school, you know, school songs. But I liked music then. I didn’t care about singing that much, but you know, you joined in class vocals.
Did you take trumpet lessons in school?
